Can consistently repro by flicking the mouse up while inside the scene or script editor, as well as resizing. The flicking crash seems to happen when transitioning the mouse into the header bar of the window.

Another interesting thing is, that _sometimes_ after crashing (more frequent if the crash occurs from trying to resize), the scaling of the editor changes to be smaller on next restart (it looks like it's going from 200% to 150%, since it is set to "Auto" in my settings). When this happens, I can't get it to crash the same way again. However, if I then manually restart, the scaling changes back, and I can make the crash happen again. And no, manually setting the scaling does not prevent the crash.

### System info
- Distro: EndeavourOS Linux x86_64 (Arch based)
- Kernel: 7.0.3-arch1-2
- Desktop Env: GNOME 50.1 (Wayland)
- CPU: AMD Ryzen 7 5800XT
- GPU: AMD Radeon RX 9070 XT
- Display scaling set to 200% on a 4k monitor

### Engine info
- Godot Engine v4.6.2.stable.mono.arch_linux (001aa128b1cd80dc4e47e823c360bccf45ed6bad)
- Installed through pacman
- Running in single-window mode

Since I was unable to ever reporoduce the issues myself I would appreciate if you could retest with a build that has these changes, Ive also uploaded a prebuilt binary here if you dont wanna built it yourselves:

https://github.com/ominousllama/godot/releases/tag/20260805-sr-fd-leak-fix

@ominousllama Built your branch for mono:

- Just resizing doesn't seem to crash it anymore but there is noticeable lag when resizing.
- Flicking the mouse up into the title bar now freezes the editor (forever), but doesn't straight up crash it.
- (NEW TEST) Pressing my minimize hotkey (when the window is maximized) freezes the editor as well; on the released version this also freezes for 1-2 seconds before crashing with the same `Should've received 8 bytes, instead got 1 bytes`.

So it looks like you did find the right place, but it probably gets stuck in one of the for loops.
